explication: Podman is an OCI container and image manager with CLI, REST, bindings, and machine-backed operation on macOS and Windows. The principal workflow is: a user invokes the CLI or API, a domain engine dispatches the requested container or image operation, libpod resolves specifications and persistent state, then storage, networking, and OCI execution produce the result. The README also documents pods, volumes, Kubernetes, Quadlet, rootless execution, registries, and remote machine support. Arrows reflect documented interfaces and sampled implementations; some subsystem wiring is necessarily summarized.
